title: Hangzhou weekend travel notes
summary: A travel-planning conversation captured as a flexible note body rather than an engineering template.
body_markdown:
# Weekend plan

We planned a two-day Hangzhou trip around walking, tea, and quieter lakeside areas.

## Highlights

- Start early at the north side of West Lake to avoid heavier crowds.
- Leave a long afternoon block for Lingyin and nearby tea villages.
- Keep dinner plans light because transit between scenic areas takes longer than expected.

## Suggestions for next time

Renting bikes only helps on the flatter lake sections. It is less useful once the route shifts toward temple and hill areas.
